_note: THROWAWAY spike trust configuration. Ships with the verifier; never taken from a bundle. Times UTC. Publication, signing and reliance periods are recorded separately (A9.5); the verifier's root rule reads only signing_valid_from and reliance_valid_until.

root_ksks.name: KSK-2017
root_ksks.signing_source: IANA: the root zone begins using KSK-2024 on 2026-10-11 and KSK-2017 ceases signing then (SPIKE-REPORT.md, KSK-2024 re-capture; https://www.iana.org/dnssec/files and https://www.iana.org/news/2026/root-zone-begins-using-new-ksk-2026 as cited in docs/reviews/v1-profile/CODEX-REVIEW.md F2). Corroborated by out-ksk2024/dns-snapshot.json: the root DNSKEY set's only RRSIG is by 38696, inception 2026-10-11T00:00:00Z.
root_ksks.max_validity_source: Observed, archived captures: out/dns-snapshot.json (captured 2026-10-09) root DNSKEY RRSIG by 20326, inception 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z, expiration 2026-10-22T00:00:00Z = 21 d (1814400 s), the only KSK-2017 root DNSKEY RRSIG archived. Corroborating: out-ksk2024/dns-snapshot.json (captured 2026-10-12) RRSIG by 38696, 2026-10-11T00:00:00Z to 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z = 21 d. Maximum of observed windows; one KSK-2017 signature observed.
root_ksks.reliance_rule: A9.5 (OWNER DECISION 2026-10-13, after docs/reviews/v1-profile/ F2): reliance end = signing_valid_until + max_root_dnskey_rrsig_validity_s = 2026-10-11T00:00:00Z + 21 d. Replaces the withdrawn 2026-10-11T23:59:59Z end-of-day cutoff.
root_ksks.publication_source: IANA root-anchors.xml; revoked 2027-01-11 and removed from root DNSKEY 2027-03-22 (V1 derivation draft section 1). Publication and revocation are informational; the verifier does not read them.

root_ksks.name: KSK-2024
root_ksks.signing_source: IANA root-anchors.xml; first signs the root DNSKEY RRset 2026-10-11 (SPIKE-REPORT.md, KSK-2024 re-capture).
root_ksks.max_validity_source: Observed: out-ksk2024/dns-snapshot.json root DNSKEY RRSIG by 38696, 2026-10-11T00:00:00Z to 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z = 21 d.
root_ksks.reliance_rule: Open while signing: reliance end is fixed only when a signing end is recorded (A9.5).
root_ksks.publication_source: published_from not recorded in the spike; publication is informational only and not used by the verifier.
